newsitem.title: USA: Ortel shares drop after warning on orders.
newsitem.headline: Ortel shares drop after warning on orders.

text.p: Shares of Ortel Corp dropped sharply on Wednesday after the company warned that a slowdown in domestic orders in the third quarter ended January 31 may hold back its performance in the next two quarters.

On Tuesday, the company said its fourth-quarter revenues may be flat or slightly less than third-quarter revenues of $22.9 million. It said it still expected revenues to top the $15.4 million generated in the previous fourth quarter.
Shares in Ortel, which makes products to enable transmission of signals by fiber optic cable, were down 6-3/4 to 13-7/8 in early afternoon trading.
